keyPoints.en: Modal + base verb: must (rule), should (advice), can/could (ability, permission), may/might (possibility).
keyPoints.bm: Modal + kata kerja dasar: must (peraturan), should (nasihat), can/could (kebolehan, kebenaran), may/might (kemungkinan).

keyPoints.en: mustn't = forbidden; don't have to = not necessary.
keyPoints.bm: mustn't = dilarang; don't have to = tidak perlu.

keyPoints.en: Gerund after: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, keep, and after prepositions (good at drawing).
keyPoints.bm: Gerund selepas: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, keep, dan selepas kata sendi (good at drawing).

keyPoints.en: To-infinitive after: want, decide, hope, plan, agree. "Stop to do" ≠ "stop doing".
keyPoints.bm: To-infinitive selepas: want, decide, hope, plan, agree. "Stop to do" ≠ "stop doing".

keyPoints.en: Positive statement → negative tag (It is hot, isn't it?); negative → positive (They don't, do they?).
keyPoints.bm: Ayat positif → tag negatif (It is hot, isn't it?); negatif → positif (They don't, do they?).

keyPoints.en: Specials: I am → aren't I?; Let's → shall we?; Nobody → positive tag with "they".
keyPoints.bm: Kes khas: I am → aren't I?; Let's → shall we?; Nobody → tag positif dengan "they".

tip.en: Find the auxiliary verb first; if none, use do/does/did.
tip.bm: Cari kata kerja bantu dahulu; jika tiada, gunakan do/does/did.
